edbDesc: One of the most spectacular results of the properties of superfluids is known as the thermomechanical or 'fountain effect'. If a capillary tube is placed into a bath of superfluid helium and then heated, even by shining a light on it, the superfluid helium will flow up through the tube and out the top.
title: Thermomechanical Effect
pickWhy: The superfluid fountain effect occurs only in liquid helium near absolute zero.
